pages.title: Anthropic versus OpenAI
pages.why: The deck's cover

pages.title: OpenAI owns reach; Anthropic leads selected enterprise signals; neither owns the future
pages.why: A dense synthesis sets the answer, decision criteria, and reversal conditions before the evidence

pages.title: Four products put the labs in different buyer journeys
pages.why: Named products and their disclosed signals orient the reader before the scoreboards.
highlight: different stages of a buyer journey
retained paid tasks and cash contribution

pages.title: 01 / Demand and market position
pages.why: Section structure

pages.title: Enterprise model spend shifted toward Anthropic before the 2026 funding surge
pages.why: Grouped categorical snapshots show each supplier on the same survey basis without implying an elapsed-time slope.

pages.title: Anthropic passed OpenAI in Ramp purchase incidence by May 2026
pages.why: The same panel tracked both vendors monthly through the crossover.
highlight: gap narrowed through the first quarter

pages.title: OpenAI’s large funnel lacks a public conversion bridge to cash profit
pages.why: One route register separates audience, paid signals and unavailable conversion rates.

pages.title: Claude gained web share, but ChatGPT still drew six times its visits
pages.why: Matched site-visit shares show both the challenger’s gain and the incumbent’s reach

pages.title: Claude retention improved, while ChatGPT still held the older cohort advantage
pages.why: Cohort retention is a separate demand-quality signal from traffic acquisition

pages.title: Anthropic reports more than 500 large accounts; depth remains unproven
pages.why: Account thresholds reveal contract depth without pretending to know gross margin

pages.title: Multihoming makes vendor share a contest for default workflows, not exclusivity
pages.why: A workflow cycle explains why buyers can adopt two suppliers while spending shifts
highlight: switching cost specific to a workflow

pages.title: The near-term demand verdict splits between audience and paid work
pages.why: A criterion scorecard places each advantage beside the measurement and its limit

pages.title: 02 / Revenue and distribution
pages.why: Section structure

pages.title: Anthropic run-rate snapshots mix company disclosures and press reports
pages.why: Separate marks show the evidence status of each dated annualized observation.

pages.title: OpenAI’s disclosed pace rose through March; August reports put it above $40B
pages.why: Dated points now encode both elapsed time and annualized magnitude, with press evidence separated by color.

pages.title: Headline run rates cannot settle the revenue race without channel accounting
pages.why: Three comparability problems are displayed as explicit barriers to a winner claim

pages.title: OpenAI already has a second monetization engine in advertising
pages.why: The new ad figure measures an additional revenue route rather than total profitability

pages.title: Coding disclosures measure Claude Code dollars and Codex weekly reach
pages.why: A comparison table keeps users, dollars and date in their own columns

pages.title: Both firms are building services channels into enterprise distribution
pages.why: Distinct partner motions explain how pilots can become deployed workflows

pages.title: Both firms have broad cloud routes, with economics still undisclosed
pages.why: A channel table separates availability from ownership and revenue economics

pages.title: One sale can report different revenue but the same pre-compute cash
pages.why: A worked transaction flow distinguishes accounting presentation from partner cash economics.

pages.title: A 41% token-price fall needs about 69% more volume to hold revenue
pages.why: Eight modeled volume cases locate the break-even point as price compression changes revenue.

pages.title: Partner take shifts the break-even serving-cost boundary
pages.why: The plotted zero-contribution points make the joint effect of partner take and serving cost visible.

pages.title: The 12–24 month commercial call is split, with revenue quality unresolved
pages.why: A compact scorecard converts the preceding evidence into a scoped near-term verdict

pages.title: 03 / Models, agents and trust
pages.why: Section structure

pages.title: Claude Opus 5.5 led the latest independent intelligence snapshot
pages.why: A dated metric tile avoids treating one September ranking as a permanent moat
highlight: a frontier rank is evidence of current capability

pages.title: GPT-6 Astra matched Fable 5.1 on coding at lower measured task cost
pages.why: Matched native-harness results separate quality from economics

pages.title: The September model verdict changes with the task and cost denominator
pages.why: One table separates current same-index measures from the earlier coding-agent test.

pages.title: Five tested models occupy distinct quality and cost positions
pages.why: A single index version supplies paired scores and task costs for both vendors.

pages.title: Five buyer and procurement routes show different published proof
pages.why: A role-based map puts corresponding products side by side rather than listing each catalog separately.

pages.title: Both platforms offer agents, but enterprise controls remain feature-specific
pages.why: A product-control table shows why procurement must check the exact API route

pages.title: MCP expands interoperability, so its standard-setting value is not lock-in
pages.why: A step mechanism explains the path from protocol adoption to customer choice
highlight: common way for assistants to connect to tools and data

pages.title: Trust controls differ by route and require buyer-specific verification
pages.why: Separate company columns let procurement compare documented state for each control.

pages.title: 04 / Capital structure and compute
pages.why: Section structure

pages.title: OpenAI disclosed the larger raise; Anthropic had the higher May mark
pages.why: Three financing states distinguish amount, pricing and what can become available cash.

pages.title: Committed equity, funded cash and credit access are different capital states
pages.why: One instrument ledger keeps round commitments, actual tranches, available credit and future uses separate.

pages.title: Private valuations outran public financial disclosure
pages.why: Four figures show pricing movement without implying audited asset value
highlight: $380 billion in February to $965 billion in May

pages.title: OpenAI’s last published cap table gave Foundation control and Microsoft 27%
pages.why: Ownership composition uses the dated October 2025 recapitalization only

pages.title: Mission control follows distinct voting paths at the two PBCs
pages.why: Two parallel chains show who holds the vote, how directors are chosen and where control lands.

pages.title: Capital strength depends on funded liquidity after timed obligations
pages.why: A cash-coverage flow shows how funding and timed obligations lead to usable runway.

pages.title: Compute contract face values are large; payment timing is undisclosed
pages.why: A contract register separates duration, counterparties and announced from delivered capacity

pages.title: OpenAI leads disclosed financing access; neither has a provably better capital structure
pages.why: A judgment table grades only what the evidence can support

pages.title: 05 / Paths to the long-run result
pages.why: Section structure

pages.title: Today’s signals split; long-run economic leadership remains unranked
pages.why: Three stages show what must happen before a broad-platform winner emerges

pages.title: Four matched tests would resolve today’s split leadership
pages.why: A common scorecard compares both companies on observable end-user and cash outcomes.

pages.title: The decision rule allows Anthropic, OpenAI, split, or unranked outcomes
pages.why: Four explicit branches tie the overall result to matched demand and cash economics.

pages.title: Higher contribution per task lowers the paid-task share needed to lead
pages.why: A two-provider sensitivity quantifies the trade between task share and margin.

pages.title: One paid task can pay an application, model and cloud at once
pages.why: A value flow shows the three capture points and the contract shares that remain private.

pages.title: Short-run signals split; the long-run economic leader is unranked
pages.why: The close states scoped verdicts and the evidence needed to change them
